title: docs(plugin-view): teach the spec-shaped named list view (objectui#8255)
body:
Fixes #8255
Clause-②: no

The docs half of the objectui#7928 ruling (decision batch #70, option A). The renderer half, objectui#8254, landed as PR #9605 and honours a spec-shaped named view, including `columns` in either union arm and `filter` as rule objects. This PR makes the four pages teach that shape: the three the card names, plus the CRUD guide folded in by the seat decision `5827390159` (patch round 1, head `9c7f893d3`).

## What changed

- `packages/plugin-view/README.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx` (the same three examples in each): every named view now carries `columns`, the one key `ObjectListViewSchema` requires. The label-only `all` view in the ObjectView overview gains `columns: ['name', 'email']` (the same list as the snippet's `table.columns`), and its inline comment now says each view needs `label` and `columns`. `cheap` (Read/List) gains `columns: ['name', 'price']` and `admins` (View tabs) gains `columns: ['name', 'email']`, matching their sibling views.
- `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`, the `ObjectViewSchema` example: both views gain `columns` (the example's own `table.columns` list), and `my-deals` spells its filter as a spec rule object, `{ "field": "owner", "operator": "equals", "value": "{current_user_id}" }`, instead of the ObjectQL tuple. The value is the spec's `CONTEXT_TOKENS` spelling (patch round 1; it was an invented `${currentUser.id}` nothing resolves), and one sentence beside the example says the host that renders the list resolves the token, with the `object-view` node path tracked in objectui#10506. The view is again written `label`-first. The old order only existed to keep a pinned line byte-identical, and that pin now reads this example differently (see below).
- `content/docs/guide/building-crud-app.md` (patch round 1): `TaskSchema.listViews.active.filter` becomes the rule object `{ field: 'status', operator: 'not_equals', value: 'Done' }` instead of the tuple.
- `.changeset/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.md` (patch round 1): the one sentence this PR falsified now reads in the past tense (the spec refused the named views the docs taught when the entry was written; objectui#8255 has since rewritten them). The front matter is byte-identical.
- `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` (patch round 1): the 7779 pin's ledger row gains the guide page in `reads`, because `--audit` refuses an unadjudicated document the pin now resolves.
- No renderer, type or schema change.

## Validation against the installed spec

Schema: `ObjectListViewSchema` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`, **`@objectstack/spec@17.4.0`**, resolved from `packages/types` (the `^17.4.0` range there, `^17.0.0` in `plugin-view`, same install). This scratch script was not committed. It finds every fenced block in the three pages that mentions `listViews` and parses it with the TypeScript parser (a `json` body is wrapped in an initializer). For each `listViews` property it turns the literal into a value and runs each entry through `ObjectListViewSchema.safeParse`.

Before (base `39395455a`), 12 entries in 7 blocks, **8 refused**:

After (this branch), **all 12 accepted, controls refused**:


Patch round 1, over four pages (the CRUD guide added). Base `39395455a`: `SUMMARY listViews blocks=8 entries accepted=5 refused=9 controls=pass` (the extra refusal: `content/docs/guide/building-crud-app.md:130 (ts) listViews.active -> filter.0: invalid_type`). Head `9c7f893d3`:

```
SUMMARY listViews blocks=8 entries accepted=14 refused=0 controls=pass
```

The card named three examples. Measured, **seven blocks carried eight refused entries**: the `cheap` and `admins` views in both the README and the mdx were refused too (no `columns`), so all of them are rewritten.

## The pin that held the old forms, and its successor

`packages/types/src/__tests__/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts` pinned the refused forms off disk as "still what the docs teach". That was the input to the measurement keeping `listViews` ledgered. Rewriting the docs turned it red, as designed. Before the successor was written it failed one test out of 233 (`expected '# @object-ui/plugin-view…' to contain 'listViews: { all: { label: 'All User…'`).

That test is replaced by its successor and is not weakened. The new test reads every named view the four pages author off disk (three, plus the CRUD guide from patch round 1), using the TypeScript parser, and requires each one to parse under `ObjectListViewSchema`. It requires at least one entry per page, so a page cannot pass vacuously. It also runs a positive control through the same predicate: the retired label-only and tuple forms must come back refused, and the spec shape must not. The spec-side refusal assertions in the test before it are unchanged; only its title and comments moved to the past tense. The file header sentence that said the docs "teach" the refused forms is updated the same way. The pin reads all four pages, and its `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` ledger row names all four in `reads` (`--audit`: exit 0, `75 declared entries, all present`).

This PR claims the pages validate. Per AGENTS.md #9, that claim now points at this pin as the instrument that re-derives it, not at the scratch output above.

### Reverse verification (one-time, not committed)

Each leg ran through `ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor had to hit, the blob had to change on disk, and the restore was proven by blob == HEAD plus an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- **Leg A**: drop `columns` from the README's `cheap` view. Predicted red, naming that entry. Observed exit 1: `+ "packages/plugin-view/README.md:458 listViews.cheap"`. Restored, blob `e7f0e491f2b4` == HEAD.
- **Leg B**: put the tuple filter back in `schema-reference.md`. Predicted red naming `my-deals`, with the objectui#7923 pin still green. Observed exit 1: `+ "content/docs/api/schema-reference.md:853 listViews.my-deals"`, `Test Files 1 failed | 1 passed (2)`. Restored, blob `67508396a7c5` == HEAD.
- **Leg C**: set `columns: 'name'` on the README overview view, to prove `check:doc-snippets` compiles that block. Observed exit 1: `packages/plugin-view/README.md:154:43 TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'string[]'`. Restored.

- **Leg D** (patch round 1): put the tuple back in the CRUD guide. Observed exit 1: `+ "content/docs/guide/building-crud-app.md:89 listViews.active"`, `Tests 1 failed | 228 passed (229)`. Restored: blob `f390aef0ef41` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Premise check

- The card's line numbers were re-measured (see the output above).
- ⚠️ **The `default: true` half of the card's premise is already gone.** PR #7991 (objectui#7923) removed the entry-level flag and added the node-level `defaultListView`, so it is not in this diff. The rest of the premise held.

## Acceptance notes

- A present-tense paragraph in the **pending changeset `.changeset/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.md` is falsified by this PR**. It says the spec refuses "the named views this package's own README and `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` teach" (`check:changeset-claims`, report-only, flags it). That file is outside this claim's file surface, so it is left untouched here. It publishes verbatim at the next release, and the open release PR #5400 carries it. ⇒ **Corrected in patch round 1** (seat decision `5827390159`, option A): the one sentence now reads in the past tense, and the front matter is byte-identical.
- Comments that describe the docs as still teaching the refused forms: the `listViews` ledger docblock in `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts` and the matching `UnmirroredDeclared` entry comment in `packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`. The owner is objectui#7928's mirror flip, which rewrites both. The header of `schema-reference-named-list-view-keys-7923.test.ts` says the filter line is "held verbatim" by the 7779 pin and that the running dialect is unmeasured; no carrier has been named for it. Its assertions stay green.
- `content/docs/guide/building-crud-app.md` also teaches a named view the spec refuses: `TaskSchema.listViews.active` uses the tuple `[['status', '!=', 'Done']]`, refused by the spec's `ObjectSchema.listViews` at `active.filter.0`, while the rule-object spelling parses. It was not one of this card's three pages. ⇒ **Folded in by patch round 1** (seat decision `5827390159`): the rule-object spelling now, and the page joins the pin.
- `my-deals` keeps its value `${currentUser.id}`, because only the dialect was in scope. Nothing resolves that value on an `object-view` node. `SchemaRenderer` does not evaluate `listViews` (the spec's `expressionBindableTextKeysFor('object-view')` is empty), and plugin-view, plugin-grid and plugin-list have zero `resolveFilterPlaceholders` / `current_user_id` / `useFilterScope` reads. For comparison, app-shell's `ObjectView.tsx` has 3. The spec's context token is `{current_user_id}`. ⇒ **Patch round 1** (seat decision `5827390159`, option B): the example now uses `{current_user_id}`, with one sentence naming the host that resolves it; the `object-view` node path's gap is filed as objectui#10506.
